Appearance:

Ms. Nupur Dhamija - Dy.G.A. for the respondent No.1/Sta
 Order

This is the first application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.163/2024 registered at Police Station Javar, District Sehore (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376(2)(n) & 109 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act..

The applicant is in custody since 20.01.2025.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against present applicant is of helping the co-accused Hariom in abducting and committing rape with the minor prosecutrix.

On the basis of which,
offence was registered against the present applicant and co-accused persons under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
She is in custody since 20.01.2025.
Present applicant is the lady.
She is not the main accused.
It is submitted that co- accused Devraj Malviya has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 09.01.2025 passed in MCRC. No.112/2025.
It is further submitted that in the statement recorded under Section 161, name of present applicant is not mentioned.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6214 2 MCRC-4993-2025 There is no criminal antecedents of the applicant.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and prayed for it's rejection.

sentences.text: Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that she shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

She shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
